explanation: The Almighty Creator who gave His Son to free us from sin and give us full sonship.
The status of being children of God through faith in Christ, which grants the right to an inheritance in God's kingdom.
The concept of eternal life and the blessings that come with being a child of God.
The state of submission under the law or the power of sin before one is freed through Christ.
The spiritual liberation from the demands of the law and the dominion of sin that Jesus has secured for believers.
The Mosaic Law with its commandments and rules, which cannot give righteousness or life in itself.
The Holy Spirit who dwells in the hearts of believers and testifies that they are God's children.
The great patriarch whose descendants, through faith, are counted as heirs together with Christ.
